description: This file defines the class ConfigImporterFieldPurger, which manages the purging of field data during configuration synchronization in Drupal, including initializing batch processing, identifying fields to purge, and executing the purge process.

classes.name: ConfigImporterFieldPurger
classes.description: Handles the purging of field data prior to configuration synchronization in Drupal.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes fields targeted for purge during configuration sync, managing batch deletion and progress tracking.

methods.name: initializeSandbox
methods.description: Sets up the batch context for field deletion, calculating total steps and preparing data.

methods.name: getFieldStoragesToPurge
methods.description: Determines which field storages need to be purged based on extensions and deletions during config sync.
